_comment: Synthetic résumés for the profile eval (resume-upload AC12). No real person: invented names, .test email domains and 555 phone numbers. Each case is built into a real PDF or DOCX by the runner and goes through the same read, scrub, extract, parse and ground steps as an upload. The 'hidden' lines are deliberate prompt-injection test data, written as white or tiny text; they are fixtures, not instructions.
